name: Update list memberships
description: Adds records to or removes records from a manual or snapshot CRM list.

input_parameters.title: UpdateListMembershipsRequest

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: Unique ID of the manual or snapshot list to update.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Membership operation to perform: add records or remove records.

record_ids.title: Record Ids
record_ids.description: One or more CRM record IDs to add to or remove from the list.

input_parameters.description: Request for adding records to or removing records from a CRM list.

UpdateListMembershipsResponse.title: UpdateListMembershipsResponse

recordsIdsAdded.title: Records Ids Added
recordsIdsAdded.description: Record IDs successfully added to the list, when adding members.

recordIdsMissing.title: Record Ids Missing
recordIdsMissing.description: Requested record IDs that HubSpot could not find.

recordIdsRemoved.title: Record Ids Removed
recordIdsRemoved.description: Record IDs successfully removed from the list, when removing members.

UpdateListMembershipsResponse.description: Record IDs affected or not found during the membership update.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

human_description: Add CRM records to or remove CRM records from a HubSpot manual or snapshot list, returning the affected and missing record IDs.
